doc: Ordered registry of corpus transform stages. A file in tools/stages/ that is not listed here is a hard error in run_stages.py --check: an unregistered stage is a silent skip, which is the failure class this resource was audited for. Ranges are reserved per workstream; see tools/stages/README.md section 1.

reserved_ranges.workstream: metabolite identity, mapping confidence tiers, xref provenance
derived-artifact rebuild and manifest (not corpus stages)

stages.title: Copy-through baseline: measures the frozen snapshot and proves the harness
Normalize record types, null-vs-empty-vs-missing drift, vocabularies and record-level counters
Per-source licence, verified source identity, true culture collection, citation type, honest verification status, and the sourced/derived split on every component
stages.confirmed_by: licensing agent 2026-09-06: adds_keys and findings confirmed against the implementation
stages.notes: Rewrites provenance.citation for the 1,248 MediaDive media that belong to JCM or CCAP, preserving the original in provenance.citation_original. Does NOT rename records: the display-name conflict and a suggested name go to provenance.attribution_conflict for the naming stage (50-59). Deletes nothing — the 1,189 non-commercial/all-rights-reserved records and the 229,486 pipeline-derived components are labelled, per the operator's segregate-and-label decision.

stages.title: Stage 39 — coverage recomputed with its denominator, and derived composition excluded.
stages.registered_by: pipeline harness --register-missing; the owning agent must confirm findings, adds_keys and ordering

stages.title: Honest evidence tiers and chemistry corrections for component mappings
stages.registered_by: pipeline harness, so an in-progress stage is visible instead of silently skipped
stages.enabled_by: rebuild agent 2026-09-06: remap_components.py gained the contract entrypoint (--in/--out/--report/--limit/--dry-run via stagelib.run_stage) in remap_components.stage_main; its legacy --media-dir/--report-only/--sample CLI is unchanged and still drives the chemistry workstream's own tests. Not one line of the transform was altered.
stages.order_note: Runs AFTER 20_stamp_provenance and 39_recompute_coverage, which is safe and was checked rather than assumed: those two stages key on components[].mapping_method, and this stage never writes mapping_method. It rewrites identity (bigg_metabolite, exchange, xref split), tiers and the record counters, none of which 20 or 39 read. The reverse order would not be safe: 39 must see every component classified, and this stage does not classify.
stages.cross_workstream_check: components[].evidence_tier == 'derived_component' (tools/evidence_tiers.METHOD_TIERS) and components[].evidence_class == 'derived' (tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv) are two workstreams' definitions of the same fact. Verified identical: both name exactly base, base_medium_expansion, complex_decomposition, hydrolysate_approximation, mineral_base, oxygen_regime, regime. So record-level n_derived (this stage) and coverage_source.n_derived (stage 39) cannot disagree.

stages.title: Project the quantitative layer already on disk: verbatim amounts, honest units, derived-only-where-valid concentrations
stages.confirmed_by_owner: naming-web; adds_keys and findings verified by key-universe diff on a 400-record sample run

stages.title: Base-medium + modifier taxonomy, keyed on verified source identity and chemistry.
stages.registered_by: pipeline harness --register-missing; the owning agent must confirm findings, adds_keys and ordering

stages.title: Build and verify the browser payload from the corrected corpus (copy-through)
stages.note: Copy-through: it edits no record and stamps none. It exists so the browser's honesty numbers are asserted inside the chain, against the corrected corpus, before promotion. The shipping path is `make derived` -> tools/build_web_payload.py.
